paper_title: What are they talking about Benchmarking Large Language Models for   Knowledge-Grounded Discussion Summarization
caption: Expert win rates 0.90\% in EBS feedback judgment. Our annotations achieve an average win rate of 88.890.90\%. All 12 LLMs exceed an 820.90\% rate in preferring our EBS.
model_annotation: The bar chart displays the expert win rates (in percent) of twelve large language models as evaluated in a benchmark for knowledge-grounded discussion summarization, based on EBS (Expert-Based Summarization) feedback judgments; the y-axis represents the win rate percentage ranging from 0 to 100 with no visible tick marks or gridlines, while the x-axis lists the models in a fixed, non-sorted order: GPT-4o, GPT-4-turbo, GPT-4o-mini, Claude 3 Opus, Claude 3.5 Sonnet, Claude 3.5 Haiku, Gemini 1.5 Pro, Llama-3.1-405B, Mistral Large, DeepSeek-V3, Qwen-Max, and GLM-4-Plus. Each model is represented by a distinct colored bar with its corresponding win rate value labeled above: GPT-4o (88.89%, dark gray), GPT-4-turbo (84.38%, teal), GPT-4o-mini (91.67%, lavender), Claude 3 Opus (97.56%, medium blue), Claude 3.5 Sonnet (83.12%, mauve), Claude 3.5 Haiku (88.46%, light blue), Gemini 1.5 Pro (86.25%, tan), Llama-3.1-405B (87.04%, sky blue), Mistral Large (97.14%, light purple), DeepSeek-V3 (91.14%, beige), Qwen-Max (82.26%, light gray), and GLM-4-Plus (92.54%, pale pink). The chart includes a red annotation labeled “Average” pointing to the GPT-4o bar, indicating that the overall average win rate across all models is 88.89%, and the caption notes that all 12 models exceed an 82% preference rate for the EBS annotations, with Claude 3 Opus achieving the highest win rate at 97.56% and Qwen-Max the lowest at 82.26%.
